name: Specialist
theme: Apotheosis of the Avatar. Pick one element at ascendancy time — Pyromancer / Cryomancer / Stormcaller — chosen element ascends; others scale beneath it.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Pick one element at ascendancy time. Chosen element gains +50% damage; other elements gain +25%. Element-swap procs no longer reset chosen element charge.'
Pairs with sorcerer.json specialist path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Avatar of Element + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~32 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Element Crit.

Specialist is sub-typed at ascendancy time (Pyromancer/Cryomancer/Stormcaller). Phase E1 ships the universal version — element-pick UI + chosen-element protection lands in Phase F. The 6 affinity + mastery nodes apply to ALL three elements until then.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 7 of 8 nodes wireable today — heaviest wire-rate of any ascendancy yet (incFire/Cold/Lightning damage stat sticks + whileTag(ignite/chill/shock) damageMult). Avatar of Element capstone needs Phase F (player-pick UI + chosen-element charge protection).

nodes.name: Element Crit
nodes.description: +5/10/15% crit damage (broad amplifier — pairs with element-conditional whileTag bonuses below).
